# Jeza Mancenido

This is the same writing as the website, in a form that is easy for people and machines to read.

Portrait: https://www.jezamancenido.com/assets/jeza-mancenido-1.jpg

## About

I build new products, marketplaces and developer platforms before the playbook exists.

I care about the “so what?” of technology. What does it actually help people do? Does it make us more capable, more creative, more connected?

Currently based in Los Angeles after a decade as a New Yorker. Forever Aussie and Knicks fan.

## Now

- Building a two-sided consumer marketplace from 0→1.
- Working theories about AI, agents and the future of work. https://twitter.com/jezamancenido
- Trying new AI tools and studying philosophy, psychology and technological change.
- Hosting dinners and book clubs in LA. https://x.com/jezamancenido/status/2097024514609815948?s=20
- Experimenting with art and science, powered by agents. https://mood.jezamancenido.com/

## Thinking about

On the website these questions rotate in a short list. They are listed here so they can be read without JavaScript.

- What makes a new tool useful enough to become part of someone’s life?
- If AI can make fifty versions of anything, what makes one worth making?
- How do you build a marketplace where people find things they trust and builders find customers?
- How do you charge for the value a product creates without making it harder to access?
- How do you build a team that can move quickly and still question whether it is solving the right problem?
- How do we know an AI agent is making someone more capable?

More real-time thoughts on X: https://twitter.com/jezamancenido

## Selected work

### By problem

### Finding product-market fit

2026-present. Consumer marketplace. Owning product-market fit on a two-sided marketplace: customer insight, distribution, partnerships and trust.

### Partnerships, distribution and new markets

2010-2013. Google Cloud · Asia Pacific. Opened partner-led markets across APAC with reseller programs and partner distribution. Revenue grew more than 300% in six months.

### Commercialization and developer platforms

2016-2018. Google Maps Platform. Turned a widely used Maps API and SDK into a commercial platform: pricing and packaging, pay-as-you-go, partner lifecycle and public-impact access.
Introducing Google Maps Platform: https://mapsplatform.google.com/resources/blog/introducing-google-maps-platform/

2014-2015. Google Maps Platform. Got enterprises and resellers onto the APIs and SDKs through trusted testing, technical guides and self-serve support.

### Operating through sudden scale

2019-2022. Google Meet. Set the operating structure for product, engineering and go-to-market when daily usage exploded overnight.
Bringing Google Meet to more people: https://blog.google/products-and-platforms/products/workspace/bringing-google-meet-to-more-people/

### Reverse chronological

2026-present. Consumer marketplace. Owning product-market fit on a two-sided marketplace: customer insight, distribution, partnerships and trust.

2025. Meta AI. Helped post-training research operations scale across product, engineering, legal and global operations.

2023. Google ChromeOS. Reset product direction on a developer-experience portfolio.

2019-2022. Google Meet. Set the operating structure for product, engineering and go-to-market when daily usage exploded overnight.
Bringing Google Meet to more people: https://blog.google/products-and-platforms/products/workspace/bringing-google-meet-to-more-people/

2019. Google Meet hardware. Strategy and operations for a hardware meeting product.

2019. Google Jamboard. Strategy and operations for a hardware whiteboard, including running release engineering for Android on device. The hardware was later wound down.

2016-2018. Google Maps Platform. Turned a widely used Maps API and SDK into a commercial platform: pricing and packaging, pay-as-you-go, partner lifecycle and public-impact access.
Introducing Google Maps Platform: https://mapsplatform.google.com/resources/blog/introducing-google-maps-platform/

2014-2015. Google Maps Platform. Got enterprises and resellers onto the APIs and SDKs through trusted testing, technical guides and self-serve support.

2010-2013. Google Cloud · Asia Pacific. Opened partner-led markets across APAC with reseller programs and partner distribution. Revenue grew more than 300% in six months.

2008-2010. PwC Australia. M&A strategy and post-merger integration after a large Australian health acquisition.
